description: The Lemma-T i=2 twisted rebuild at order 668: the check_record-format frame record for the SECOND Hadamard matrix of order 668 banked in this repository. Derived independently from data/payload-records.json (the decoded s=1, i=1 record) by the character twist of NOTE-B.md S1.4, together with the s=1/i=2 border system (E, P, col_table) solved in the lab's bordered-GS theorem experiment.

derivation.seeds: x'_q(g) = psi(g) * x_q(g) with psi the nontrivial character of G = Z_166, psi(g) = +1 if g even, -1 if g odd; x_q are the seeds of the order-668 record in data/payload-records.json, byte-for-byte
derivation.coset_divisors: [2]: kappa(g) = g mod 2, K = ker(kappa) = 2*Z_166, index i = 2, w = |K| = 83
derivation.psi_rho: psi(rho) = -1 at rho = 165, so NOTE-B.md S1.4's proposition does NOT collapse this twist to a diagonal conjugation -- this is why the rebuild can and does leave the equivalence class (cert 06)
derivation.border: E = corner, P = row_table, Q = the 4i x 4s column table; col_table[r][k] = Q[k][r] is the check_record transpose convention. Source: the i=2 border system solved in the lab's twist_report.json for order 668 (H2/H3/H4 all true there, and re-checked from scratch by cert 06)
